Advertisements
Product descriptions
Website content
Social media posts
Email campaigns
Blog articles
Scripts and basic storyboards

Follow internal SOPs and creative processes.
Maintain proper documentation and file organization.

Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, Marketing, Literature, or related field.

Basic understanding of branding, advertising, or digital marketing.
Good research and proofreading skills.
Ability to take feedback constructively.
Creative thinking with attention to detail.
Proactive and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.
